conversion: Main wood simplified per connected component, lowest 3cm locked; near also locks borders, far relaxes boundary simplification. All leaf/twig components partitioned by spatial centroid into .65m/1.05m cells. Every cell baked in three positive axis views without fixed lighting. Three orthogonal alpha cards per spatial cluster, identical image on both sides. Base alpha coverage corrected against supersampled area. Same scanned volume and root for both LODs; no whole-tree billboard. Source branch texture repeat [15,3.4], offset [0,-2.4] applied only during bake.

bake.kind: Unlit photographed albedo and 65% source AO; three orthographic axis views per actual spatial cluster; supersampled area-preserved base alpha; no sun or backdrop
